premium.basis: Based on closing price of $198.65 on 2014-11-14, the last trading day before announcement.

leaked_early.details: Actavis approach reported by Bloomberg/WSJ in September 2014, about two months before official announcement.

notes: Allergan fended off a hostile Valeant/Pershing Square bid and accepted a white-knight merger with Actavis at $219/share, representing a 10.2% premium over the last close, but shares had already risen significantly from the hostile bid and long-term growth.
